entry.title: Dover Castle

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: Inspected aerial picture confirms the square Great Tower, concentric mural towers, gatehouses, church/pharos group and later barracks. The retained east/south site frame and standard viewer PMTiles set approximate location, scale and orientation. The derivative omits the embedded hill, uses host PMTiles terrain, reconstructs level keep/church floors above coarse sampled ground and extends their bounded wall bottoms beneath it. Anchor 1.322679734,51.129258466; heading 0; standard PMTiles datum 110.20328505915221m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
